set.body:
Objective
Repair the remaining public-contract and cogency defects across fmrireg.Rmd, a_05_contrasts.Rmd, a_10_dataset.Rmd, and multisubject_fanout.Rmd.

Required work
- Remove or replace the nonexistent afni_lm API claim.
- Give the overview an early runnable end-to-end fit using a small current-source dataset.
- Execute the central contrast fit and result extraction; remove error=TRUE from teaching code and replace verbose internal dumps with compact output.
- Correct event_table documentation: rows represent events, not scans.
- Qualify fmri_job size and portability for inline versus file-backed data and worker dependencies.
- Add consistent prerequisite and Next links across the article sequence.

Acceptance criteria
- Every named public function exists and every central example executes.
- No core teaching step is hidden behind eval=FALSE solely for a tiny example.
- Data ownership and event-table contracts agree with implementation.
- Article navigation forms a coherent route from overview through data, simulation, modeling, contrasts, multi-subject/group, connectivity, and acceleration/plugin topics.
- All affected vignettes render cleanly and visibly concise.
set.title: Refresh public contracts and make the vignette learning path executable
